items.title: Babe Stovall Interview, 1974-04-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Walker, why did you decide to come to New Orleans? To live here. [INTERVIEWEE] For me. For me. For me. For me. For me. For me. For me. For me. For me. For me.

ctx.x: Would you get an iron? Would they pay you? No, you're sure. For New Year's Eve? Yeah. What about birthdays? It's seven hours. You don't have a telephone, but they have a telephone downstairs. Yeah. Okay. I see. We asked you about those trump piano players. Did you know any of them? Their names? Do you know any of them? Yeah. God, you play blues.
Walker, why did you decide to come to New Orleans? To live here.
For me. For me. For me. For me. For me. For me. For me. For me. For me. For me.
